feedback: Where learners cast one group as the sole cause, surface the chain of demand connecting consumers, producers and land clearance.
activities.intendedInsight: Behind forest loss sit real people with competing economic motives; deforestation decisions involve trade-offs, not simple villains.
learnerActions: Hear from or role-play a rancher, a logger and a conservationist, each stating their motives for and against clearing forest.
Identify the competing demands and trade-offs behind a single cleared patch.
activities.title: Optional: competing stakeholders (deferred extension)
